text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan had a great showing in the 
Ocean Stakes. The response to the "Kawaii 
Derby♪" was fantastic as well.

However, her rival in the next race, Biko 
Pegasus, was in an entirely different 
league when it came to popularity on 
"Umatok."

However, Curren Chan seemed to have a 
secret plan of her own. Keeping it close 
to her heart, she advanced to the first 
race of the "Kawaii Derby♪"—the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
